newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Theme unit to merge with China sock maker.
newsitem.headline: Theme unit to merge with China sock maker.

text.p: Hong Kong fashion retailer Theme International Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its 40 percent owned unit Fitlady Investment Holdings Ltd would merge with Mega Concord (China) Investment Ltd in April.
In a statement, Theme said China-based Mega Concord was the largest maker of socks in Asia.
Fitlady distributes women's stockings and hosiery products in Hong Kong, China and Southeast Asia, and has manufacturing facilities in China's southern Guangdong province.
Theme gave no more details of the merger.
It said Fitlady had interim net profits of HK$39.5 million on turnover of HK$124 million for the six months ended September 30, 1996.
Theme shares were up HK$0.025 at HK$3.425 at midday on Tuesday.
